Staff Combat Styles

Choose Staff for extra pressure on controlled targets or for attacks that disorient and knock down.

Staff - Crusher

Crusher gains extra damage against targets with control effects, including those applied by allies, and includes attacks that can daze. Charged Blows and Skull Rattle require you to apply the control effect yourself.

Staff - Sentinel

Sentinel includes a line attack and strikes that can knock targets down or disorient them.

Quick Answers

What does Staff focus on?

Choose Staff for extra pressure on controlled targets or for attacks that disorient and knock down.
